clinical_summary: Sponsor exact current authorized upcoming FAM-010 / Illinois Urbana, inquiry route only; not claiming dose-group enrollment. Confirmed splenic HSA before enrollment, splenectomy and first dose within 21 days, no prior systemic therapy or RT or planned breeding. Sponsor covers screening, study treatment and follow-up, owner travel. Exact sponsor form contact; study dates not specified.

previous.funding: Familiar covers study screening, FAM-010 treatment and study follow-up care. Owners pay travel to and from Urbana. Coverage of the preceding splenectomy or unrelated care is not specified.
previous.special_requirement: Enrollment is announced as enrolling soon; ask about the next dose group before arranging care. Splenic hemangiosarcoma must be confirmed by pathology before joining, but owners awaiting results or with splenectomy scheduled may inquire now. The first dose must be possible within 21 days after splenectomy. No previous chemotherapy, radiation or other investigational drug; no intended breeding. Regular Urbana visits are required. This initial study establishes dose and side effects; improved survival and reduced heart toxicity are not established. Permanent infertility is expected in intact male dogs.
